questions.question: After hearing Assyria's threats, King Hezekiah tore his clothes and put on sackcloth. Where did he go?
Through the prophet Isaiah, what did the LORD say would happen to the king of Assyria after he returned to his own land?

answers.text: He would fall by the sword
He would rule there in peace
He would gather a bigger army

questions.question: In his prayer, King Hezekiah said the LORD was just one god among many over the kingdoms of the earth. True or false?
When King Hezekiah prayed for rescue from Sennacherib of Assyria, why did he ask God to save Judah?

answers.text: So all kingdoms would know He alone is God
So Judah could rule over Assyria
So Hezekiah could keep his throne
